memo.summary: Context-only shadow deliberation as of 2026-09-01. The measured tape remains risk-on and the risk radar is calm, with its 21-day pullback rate below base (13.0% versus 17.8%); this does not support originating or escalating a risk claim. The more important context is transition risk: the confirmed US regime remains Q2 Reflation, but the current axes indicate raw Q3 (growth -0.40, inflation +0.24), only 1 of 7 required confirmation sessions. Liquidity is neutral-hollow rather than stressed: the RRP buffer is exhausted, but credit is tight, financial conditions are loose, and no stress confirmation is present. Factor evidence is immature: only 11 panel dates, no surviving scorecard factors, composite untradeable, Pair G dormant, and zero graded factor-attention firings. The graded spine extract is dominated by unsigned MFE proxy records, often marked STOPPED despite positive MFE, so it is unsuitable for directional inference. Kernel evidence reinforces restraint: no engine shown is armed; US-board and radar signed-excess estimates are negative in Q2, while several apparently strong board estimates use unsigned MFE proxies or vacuous held-out tests. No new hypothesis was staked because the available evidence did not justify spending the limited weekly budget on a properly specified causal or conditional claim.
what_fired: Four shadow attention items were recorded: confirmed-Q2 versus raw-Q3 transition; the growth-over-value thesis versus its bull-flattener falsifier; overdue open master-brain theses; and stale options-skew contradictions affecting five buy-lane names.
No Pair G factor contradiction fired; the ledger is absent until the panel reaches at least 60 distinct dates.
No calibrated risk escalation fired. Risk radar is calm, credit health is healthy, and volatility is normalizing.
memo.contradictions_review: The confluence graph contains two current tensions. First, ticker-level demand/tape evidence opposes the intelligence briefing across 23 divergences; this is display-only and requires reconciliation rather than directional use. Second, GLXY, HOOD, NXPI, QCOM, and TSLA were simultaneously in the buy lane and showing five-day rising OTM-put skew as of 2026-08-21. That options witness is stale relative to this deliberation and is legal only as de-escalation context. ADB-W3 review also found that the open growth-over-value underweight thesis explicitly names bull flattening as a falsifier, while the current curve regime is bull flattener. Numerous master-brain theses remain open after their check-by dates, weakening their present evidentiary value. The confirmed Q2 label is also in tension with raw Q3 axes, but confirmation is only 1/7 sessions, so this is transition attention rather than a regime claim.
decaying_families: Open master-brain theses past their stated check-by dates, including semiconductors, Bitcoin, China equities, long Treasuries, high-yield credit, and US equities.
Options-skew contradiction snapshot dated 2026-08-21; refresh is required before continued reliance.
Factor intelligence panel: history floor not met at 11 dates; Pair G remains dormant below 60 dates.

Risk-radar forward log has 25 graded observations but zero actual alerts, so alert precision remains unmeasurable.
deserves_operator: Review the Q2-to-Q3 transition only if raw Q3 persists through the seven-session confirmation rule; clear if the axes revert first.
Review master-brain growth-over-value theses because bull flattening—the stated falsifier—is currently present; do not preserve the lean without explicit human disposition.
Close, score, or formally extend every thesis whose check-by date has passed; open-ended retention is inconsistent with its pre-commitment.
Refresh the five-name options-skew contradiction set and clear it if simultaneous buy-lane membership plus rising put skew no longer holds.
Reconcile the 23 briefing-versus-tape directional divergences before using the briefing as current explanatory context.
Treat the factor scorecard and Pair G ledger as coverage gaps, not evidence of agreement or absence of borrowed strength.
